name: Ohio
notes: 2025 schedule (all statuses): $0 tax on first $26,050; $342 + 2.75% of excess over $26,050; $2,375.63 + 3.125% over $100,000 (HB 96). Flat 2.75% from 2026.

Ohio's $342 cliff at $26,050 is smoothed with a 19.85% band from $26,050 to $28,050 (2,000 x 19.85% = $342 + 2.75% x 2,000), so tax is exact at/above $28,050 and below $26,050; understated by < $342 inside the band.
Deduction = personal exemption of $2,150 per person (MAGI $40,001-$80,000 tier); actual exemption is $2,400 (MAGI <= $40,000), $1,900 ($80,001-$750,000), $0 above $750,000.
Ignored: $20/exemption credit (MAGI < $30,000), joint filing credit (percentage of tax, max $650), other credits.
School district and municipal income taxes are handled separately.
